correctness.rationale: Independently recomputed the given 4×23 ternary generator matrix rank four and Gram determinant 1, all 81 codewords and their exact Hamming weights 0:1,14:18,15:28,16:22,17:6,18:4,22:2. All 23 columns are distinct in PG(3,3); enumerated all 130 lines, obtaining intersection multiplicities 0:10,1:11,2:43,3:62,4:4, and all 40 projective hyperplanes (counts 1:1,5:2,6:3,7:11,8:14,9:9). Independently enumerated all four automorphisms of the colored 23-vertex incidence graph and confirmed each lifts to an invertible projective matrix: group has identity plus three involutions, hence Klein four. Finite exhaustive classifications are exactly finite claims, with no extrapolation.
